name: BondFixedExpiryTeller
title: The Phantom of Olympus
tagline: Born in Paris, this wounded bond still bleeds from the OlympusDAO scar.

chapters.heading: The birth of the teller
paragraphs: A single candle flickers against the cold stone. On September 16, 2022, a wallet deployed the BondFixedExpiryTeller. It was born as a small program that lives on Ethereum. This child arrived during the Paris era.
The contract was forged using Solidity 0.8.15. On the day it was born, it was written into a block, one page of Ethereum's shared record book. It has lived for about 4 years now.

chapters.heading: The teller's busy days
paragraphs: The contract lived a busy life. People called it 103 times. They used the create, purchase, and redeem functions. It moved through 2 different years between 2022 and 2023.
OlympusDAO saw it on 2022-10-21. The DeFiHackLabs repository holds its story. The records show no input validation. The wound remains open.

chapters.heading: The hollow open gate
paragraphs: I am a teller contract. My address is named in the DeFiHackLabs record of the OlympusDAO incident. The record does not say what part I played. The loss belongs to OlympusDAO as a whole, not to me alone.
I have a high impact wound. It happened on October 21, 2022. I had no input validation. This flaw let the shadows in.
The loss was about $292K. That was 30500 OHM. My ghost still haunts the catalog.

chapters.heading: The ghost of OlympusDAO
paragraphs: The shadow of OlympusDAO hangs heavy over the teller. It carries a wound from a governance flaw. No compiler version or Solidity upgrade can heal this mark.

The ghost lingers because of a lack of input validation. To still the spirit, count voting power from a snapshot taken before a proposal opens. Put a delay between a vote passing and its execution so a one-transaction loan cannot pass and run a proposal.

buster.fix_reason: No compiler version fixes this wound: it is a governance flaw (cause in the record: 'No input validation'). The buster's advice is a general mitigation for that kind of flaw, written by hand, not taken from the incident's references.

mitigation.advice: Count voting power from a snapshot taken before a proposal opens, so borrowed tokens cannot vote. Put a delay between a vote passing and its execution, so a one-transaction loan cannot pass and run a proposal.
